# Epsilon Runtime Eclipse

> Packages the Eclipse Epsilon model transformation framework (v2.8) as installable Eclipse features and a P2 update site for Eclipse-based products.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (Zulu JDK), built with Maven 3.9.4 and Tycho 4.0.13
- 30+ Eclipse feature modules packaging upstream Epsilon plugins plus a custom BlackBelt runtime feature
- Produces a P2 update site aggregating 112+ artifacts (Epsilon engines, model connectors, third-party libraries)
- Supports EOL, ETL, EVL, EGL, EGX, EML, ECL model transformation language dialects
- Model connectors for EMF, UML, Simulink, CSV, GraphML, HTML, JDT, Spreadsheets/Excel
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Modules — Custom Runtime

- [epsilon-runtime.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](epsilon-runtime.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Custom BlackBelt runtime feature wrapping the hu.blackbelt.epsilon.runtime-execution plugin

## Modules — Epsilon Core

- [org.eclipse.epsilon.core.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.core.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Core Epsilon parsers and execution engines (EOL, ETL, EVL, EGL, EGX, EML, ECL)
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.core.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.core.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Eclipse IDE development tools for Epsilon languages

## Modules — EMF Integration

- [org.eclipse.epsilon.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): EMF-based model management
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.emf.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.emf.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): EMF development tools for Eclipse
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.evl.emf.validation.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.evl.emf.validation.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): EMF model validation using EVL
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.ewl.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.ewl.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): EWL wizard integration with EMF
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.ewl.gmf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.ewl.gmf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): GMF graphical editor integration
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.eunit.dt.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.eunit.dt.emf.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): EUnit testing tools for EMF models
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.flexmi.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.flexmi.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): FlexMI flexible model import
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.flexmi.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.flexmi.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): FlexMI development tools

- [org.eclipse.epsilon.emc.jdt.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.emc.jdt.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): JDT development tools

- [org.eclipse.epsilon.simulink.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.simulink.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Simulink model connector

## Modules — Additional Features

- [org.eclipse.epsilon.hutn.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.hutn.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): HUTN (Human Usable Textual Notation) parser
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.hutn.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.hutn.dt.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): HUTN development tools
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.picto.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.picto.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Picto model visualization
- [org.eclipse.epsilon.sirius.widget.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml](org.eclipse.epsilon.sirius.widget.feature/src/main/resources/feature.xml): Sirius widget for embedding Epsilon in Sirius

## Modules — Update Site

- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): P2 site generation aggregating 112+ artifacts with p2-maven-plugin
- [site/category.xml](site/category.xml): P2 update site category definitions (17 categories)
